name: Data Science
description: Introduction to data science; data pre-processing: cleaning, transformation; exploratory data analysis: visualization, statistical analysis; clustering and dimensionality reduction: K-means, PCA; classification: K-NN, logistic regression, decision trees; regression analysis; neural networks basics; data modeling: schema design, ER diagrams; SQL: joins, aggregations, recursive queries; tools: python (pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn), SQL.
